policy: All records draft / needs_source_review. Key signs and principles are NCCAOM-level study drafts pending textbook verification. typical_points/typical_formulas left for E3 after cross-check.

records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify lung qi
Nourish Yin, moisten the Lungs, clear Heat, stop cough
records.short_summary_zh: 肺陰虧虛，虛熱內生，肺失清肅。以乾咳少痰、痰中帶血、口乾咽燥、五心煩熱、午後潮熱、盜汗為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Depletion of Lung Yin leading to internal Deficiency-Heat and loss of Lung moistening function. Characterized by dry cough with little sputum, blood-streaked sputum, dry throat, tidal fever, and night sweats.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue body with scanty coating and dry fluids

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 肺系虛熱證：乾咳少痰、痰中帶血、潮熱盜汗為三大診斷要點。多由久咳傷陰、熱病後期傷津引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Lung System Deficiency-Heat: Key features are dry cough, blood-streaked sputum, and night sweats. Caused by chronic cough or febrile fluid depletion.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Lung Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方百合固金湯 (Bai He Gu Jin Tang) 或沙參麥冬湯。主穴：LU9 太淵、KI6 照海、LU5 尺澤、BL13 肺俞。

records.treatment_principle_en: Release the exterior with warm acrid herbs, diffuse the lung
Release the exterior with cool acrid herbs, clear lung heat
Dry damp, transform phlegm, diffuse the lung
Clear heat, transform phlegm, calm wheezing
Tonify Spleen Qi, harmonize Stomach, assist transportation
records.short_summary_zh: 脾氣虛弱，運化水谷失職。以食少腹脹、飯後尤甚、大便溏薄、神疲乏力、肢體倦怠、面色萎黃為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Weakness of Spleen Qi impairing transportation and transformation of food and water. Characterized by poor appetite, postprandial abdominal distension, loose stools, fatigue, and sallow complexion.

tongue_preview.zh: 舌質淡胖，邊有齒痕，苔薄白
tongue_preview.en: Pale swollen tongue with teethmarks and thin white coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 消化系本虛病機：食少、腹脹、便溏、氣虛為四大診斷要點。為多數脾胃病與氣血生化不足之根本。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Digestive Root Deficiency: Key indicators are poor appetite, bloating, loose stools, and tiredness. Root cause of fluid/blood deficiency.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Spleen Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方四君子湯 (Si Jun Zi Tang) 或參苓白朮散。主穴：ST36 足三里、SP6 三陰交、RN12 中脘、BL20 脾俞。

records.treatment_principle_en: Warm the middle, fortify the spleen
Tonify middle qi, raise the sunken
Fortify the spleen, boost qi to contain blood
Clear heat, transform damp
Warm the middle, dispel cold-damp
Clear stomach fire
Nourish stomach yin
Reduce food stagnation, guide out accumulation
Course the liver, resolve depression, regulate qi
Clear liver fire
Calm the liver, subdue yang, nourish liver-kidney
records.short_summary_zh: 肝腎陰虛於下，水不涵木，致使肝陽偏亢、上擾清空。以頭痛眩暈、急躁易怒、面紅目赤、腰膝痠軟為主要臨床特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Liver and Kidney Yin deficiency below failing to nourish Wood, allowing Liver Yang to become hyperactive and surge upward to disturb the head. Characterized by throbbing headache, dizziness, irritability, facial redness, and lumbar/knee weakness.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with scanty or thin yellow coating

pulse_preview.en: Wiry and forceful pulse, or wiry, fine and rapid

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 本虛標實（上實下虛）：上焦呈現陽亢熱象（頭痛、眩暈、面紅目赤、急躁），下焦伴隨陰虛不足（腰膝痠軟、足脛無力）。多由情志所傷或久病傷陰引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Root Deficiency with Branch Excess (Upper Excess, Lower Deficiency): Upper body shows Yang hyperactivity (headache, dizziness, facial redness), while lower body exhibits Yin deficiency (weak knees/lumbar). Often triggered by emotional stress or chronic Yin depletion.

key_signs_zh: 言語不利，甚則卒然昏仆
records.treatment_principle_en: Calm the liver, extinguish wind
Nourish blood, supplement the liver
Enrich yin, nourish the liver

records.name_en: Cold Stagnating in the Liver Channel
key_signs_zh: 少腹牽引睪丸墜脹冷痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Warm the liver, dispel cold, move qi
Clear and drain liver-gallbladder damp-heat
Tonify heart qi
Warm and supplement heart yang
Nourish blood, calm the spirit
Enrich yin, nourish the heart, calm the spirit
Clear heart fire
Invigorate blood, dispel stasis, unblock the vessels
Flush phlegm, open the portals
Warm and tonify Kidney Yang, replenish Gate of Vitality
records.short_summary_zh: 腎陽虧虛，命門火衰，溫煦失職。以腰膝酸冷、畏寒肢冷（下肢尤甚）、神疲乏力、小便清長夜尿多、陽痿或水腫為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Deficiency of Kidney Yang and decline of Gate of Vitality Fire. Characterized by cold soreness of lumbar/knees, aversion to cold with icy limbs, clear profuse nocturia, erectile dysfunction, or edema.

tongue_preview.en: Pale swollen tongue with white slippery coating

pulse_preview.en: Deep, fine, and weak pulse, especially faint in Chi position

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 腎系虛寒病機：腰膝酸冷、畏寒肢冷、夜尿多、脈沉細為四大診斷要點。與腎陰虛（熱象、手足心熱）明確對照。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Kidney Deficiency-Cold: Cold knees, aversion to cold, and nocturia are key diagnostic criteria. Clear contrast with Kidney Yin Deficiency.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr TCM Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方金匱腎氣丸 (Jin Kui Shen Qi Wan) 或右歸丸。主藥附子、肉桂溫補命門之火。

records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish Kidney Yin, enrich the root
records.short_summary_zh: 腎陰虧虛，髓海失充，虛熱內生。以腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴、失眠多夢、五心煩熱、潮熱盜汗、咽乾口燥為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Deficiency of Kidney Yin failing to nourish the marrow and generating internal Deficiency-Heat. Characterized by lumbar/knee soreness, tinnitus, insomnia, five-center heat, and night sweats.

tongue_preview.zh: 舌質紅，少苔或無苔少津
tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with scanty or absent coating

pulse_preview.en: Fine and rapid pulse, especially in the Chi position

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 腎系本虛病機：腰膝痠軟、耳鳴、虛熱（潮熱盜汗手足心熱）為三大診斷要點。為更年期、慢性腎病核心。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Kidney System Root Deficiency: Lumbar soreness, tinnitus, and deficiency-heat are key diagnostic features. Core pattern in menopausal syndrome.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr TCM Pathology & NCCAOM 考點：代表方六味地黃丸 (Liu Wei Di Huang Wan)。君藥熟地黃滋補腎陰，臣藥山茱萸、山藥，佐藥澤瀉、丹皮、茯苓三瀉三補。

records.treatment_principle_en: Replenish essence and marrow
Secure kidney qi
Supplement the kidney to absorb qi
Restore heart-kidney communication
Supplement heart and spleen, nourish blood, calm the spirit
aliases_en: Heart and Spleen Deficiency of Qi and Blood
records.short_summary_zh: 心血不足，神失所養，脾氣虛弱，運化失職。以心悸怔忡、失眠多夢、健忘、食少體倦、面色萎黃為主要臨床特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Deficiency of Heart Blood depriving the Spirit of nourishment, combined with Spleen Qi deficiency impairing transportation and transformation. Characterized by palpitations, insomnia, poor memory, fatigue, and sallow complexion.

tongue_preview.en: Pale tongue with thin white coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 雙重虛證：心不主血、脾不統血與生血不足並見。常用於心悸、失眠、月經過多、崩漏等氣血兩虛證候。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Dual Deficiency: Failure of Heart to govern Blood and Spleen to produce/control Blood. Commonly seen in insomnia, palpitations, hypermenorrhea, and chronic bleeding.

records.treatment_principle_en: Course the liver, fortify the spleen
Course the liver, harmonize the stomach
Enrich lung and kidney yin
Warm and supplement spleen and kidney yang
Move qi, invigorate blood, dispel stasis
Boost qi and nourish blood
Invigorate blood, dispel stasis
records.short_summary_zh: 血行不暢，瘀滯內阻，脈絡不通。以刺痛、痛有定處、夜間痛甚、拒按、唇舌紫暗或有瘀點瘀斑為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Blood circulation impaired, resulting in localized stasis obstructing collaterals. Characterized by fixed sharp stabbing pain, nocturnal aggravation, tenderness to touch, and purple lips/tongue with macules.

tongue_preview.zh: 舌質紫暗，或有瘀點瘀斑
tongue_preview.en: Purple or dark tongue with stasis dots/macules

pulse_preview.en: Fine and choppy pulse, or bound/intermittent

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 血分實證：痛如針刺、痛有定處、夜間加重為三大診斷要點。可因氣滯、寒凝、熱灼或創傷引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Blood Level Excess: Sharp stabbing pain, fixed location, and night aggravation are three key diagnostic indicators. Caused by Qi stagnation, Cold, Heat, or trauma.

records.treatment_principle_en: Clear heat, cool the blood
Clear heat, drain damp from the lower burner
Dry damp, transform phlegm
records.short_summary_zh: 脾失健運，水濕不化，凝聚成痰，阻滯氣機。以形體肥胖、身重困倦、胸悶脘痞、咳嗽痰多白黏、口黏不渴為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Spleen failing to transform fluids, leading to moisture accumulating into phlegm and obstructing Qi movement. Characterized by heaviness, obesity, chest fullness, profuse white sticky sputum, and sticky mouth.

tongue_preview.en: Swollen tongue with thick white greasy coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 實證病機：脾不運化為本，痰濕聚積為標。常表現為胸悶、噁心、咳嗽痰多、眩暈或肥胖症。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Excess Pattern: Spleen dysfunction as root, phlegm-damp accumulation as branch. Commonly manifests as chest oppression, nausea, heavy cough, dizziness, or metabolic issues.

records.treatment_principle_zh: 祛風散寒除濕，通絡止痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Dispel wind-cold-damp, unblock the channels
Clear heat, unblock the channels, dispel wind-damp
Regulate the Chong and Ren vessels

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱蘊結下焦，膀胱氣化失司。以小便頻急刺痛、尿色黃赤短少、小腹急痛、發熱惡寒為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Lower Burner, impairing Bladder Qi transformation. Characterized by frequent, urgent, burning urination with dark, scanty urine and lower abdominal distension.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue body with yellow greasy coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 下焦實熱證：以小便頻急灼熱、刺痛短赤為診斷要點。多因飲食不節（過食辛辣油脂飲酒）或外感濕熱下注引發。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Lower Burner Excess Heat: Burning urgent dysuria is key diagnostic criteria. Triggered by greasy spicy food, alcohol, or external Damp-Heat invasion.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方八正散（八正散 = 滑石、木通、車前子、萁麥、萁蓄、梔子、大黃、甘草）。核心草藥：滑石、木通、車前子、梔子、燈心草。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Dampness, unblock urination

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱久蘊下焦，煎熬尿液，凝結成砂石。以腰腹絞痛、尿中夾砂石或血尿、尿道刺痛為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat long accumulating in the Lower Burner, condensing urine into sand or stones. Characterized by severe colicky flank/abdominal pain, sand in urine, or hematuria.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with thick yellow greasy coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 實證砂石病機：腰腹陣發性絞痛、痛引少腹、排出砂石為三大診斷要點。當加「軟堅散結排石」藥。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Excess Stone Pathomechanism: Paroxysmal colicky flank pain radiating to groin and presence of gravel. Requires herbs that soften hardness and dissolve stones.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Maciocia & Bastyr 考點：必加軟堅排石核心藥對「金錢草、海金沙、雞內金」。代表方三金湯、石韋散。
records.treatment_principle_zh: 清熱利濕，通淋排石，止痛
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Damp, promote urination, expel stones, relieve pain

records.name_en: Qi Lin - Excess Type (Liver Qi Stagnation)
records.short_summary_zh: 肝氣鬱結，氣機阻滯，膀胱氣化失暢。以小便澀滯、滴瀝不暢、臍下急痛、脅肋脹滿、隨情志變化加重為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Liver Qi stagnation obstructing Qi movement and Bladder transformation. Characterized by hesitant dribbling urination, hypogastric distress, flank distension, and aggravation by emotional stress.
records.differentiation_preview_zh: 氣滯實證：排尿困難隨情緒焦慮或生氣加重，無明顯尿道灼熱，伴脅脹腹滿。治當疏肝理氣。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Qi Stagnation Excess: Dysuria worsens with stress/anger, without severe burning heat. Accompanied by flank distension.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Maciocia & Bastyr 考點：代表方沉香散 (Chen Xiang San)。疏肝理氣、利尿通淋。
records.treatment_principle_en: Soothe the Liver, regulate Qi, unblock urination

aliases_en: Dysuria with Hematuria from Blood Heat
records.short_summary_zh: 實熱下注，灼傷血絡，迫血妄行。以小便頻急刺痛、尿色鮮紅或夾有血塊、心煩口渴為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Excess Heat pouring downward into Bladder, injuring Blood collaterals and forcing Blood to spill. Characterized by sharp pain, bright red urine or blood clots, and thirst.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue body with yellow coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 血分實熱證：尿血鮮紅、割痛難忍。與虛證血淋（尿色淡紅、微痛或無痛、體倦）相對照。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Blood Level Excess Heat: Bright red urine with severe cutting pain. Contrasts with Deficiency Blood Lin (pale red urine, mild ache, fatigue).
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方小薊飲子 (Xiao Ji Yin Zi)。涼血止痛、清熱通淋。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, cool Blood, stop bleeding, unblock urination

records.short_summary_zh: 濕熱阻滯下焦，清濁不分，脂液下薛。以小便混濁如米泔水或如脂膏、尿道熱澀刺痛為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Damp-Heat obstructing Lower Burner, failing to separate clear from turbid, allowing fat/essence to spill into urine. Characterized by milky, turbid, or greasy urine with urethral discomfort.
key_manifestations_en: Greasy Fatty Substance Floating in Urine

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with white or yellow greasy coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 清濁不分病機：尿液渾濁呈米泔或脂膏狀。實證多由濕熱下注，虛證多由脾腎不固。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Turbidity Separation Pathomechanism: Milky or greasy urine appearance. Excess is caused by Damp-Heat; Deficiency is caused by Spleen/Kidney unsteadiness.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & Maciocia 考點：代表方萆薢分清飲 (Bi Xie Fen Qing Yin)。分清別濁、萆薢清熱利濕。
records.treatment_principle_en: Clear Heat, drain Dampness, separate clear from turbid

records.short_summary_zh: 久病淋濁，脾腎虧虛，正氣耗傷。以小便淋漓不已、時作時止、遇勞即發、腰膝痠軟、神疲乏力為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Chronic Lin depleting Spleen and Kidney Qi/Yin. Characterized by recurrent dribbling dysuria triggered by physical or mental exertion, accompanied by fatigue and weak lumbar/knees.

tongue_preview.en: Pale tongue with thin white coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 脾腎本虛病機：病程長，平時隱痛或微感不適，一有勞累或性生活即急性發作。治當補益脾腎。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Spleen & Kidney Root Deficiency: Chronic course, low-grade discomfort flared up by fatigue or overwork. Tx: Tonify Spleen & Kidney.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr MM2 & Maciocia 考點：代表方無比山藥丸 (Wu Bi Shan Yao Wan) 或補中益氣湯加減。益氣滋陰、固澀小便。
records.treatment_principle_en: Tonify Spleen Qi, strengthen Kidney, consolidate urination

records.short_summary_zh: 肝鬱化火，火性炎上，上擾清空。以頭痛脹裂、面紅目赤、口苦口乾、急躁易怒、項背緊繃、甚或鼻衄為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Liver Qi stagnation transforming into Fire, surging upward to agitate head and eyes. Characterized by flushed face, splitting headache, tight neck/trapezius, bitter taste, and epistaxis.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with yellow coating, red edges/tip

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 肝經純實熱證：以頭痛脹裂、面紅目赤、口苦咽乾為診斷要點。與肝陽上亢區分——本證為純實無虛，無下焦腰膝痠軟。治當清肝瀉火。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Pure Excess Heat of Liver: Characterized by splitting headache, flushed face, bitter taste without lower body Yin deficiency. Tx: Drain Liver Fire.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Therapeutics 5 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方龍膽瀉肝湯 (Long Dan Xie Gan Tang)。主穴：LR2 行間、LI4 合谷、LI11 曲池、GB20 風池、GV20 百會、ST44 內庭。
records.treatment_principle_en: Calm the Liver, drain Fire, clear head and eyes

records.short_summary_zh: 肝陽化風，風氣上擾，氣血逆亂。以眩暈劇烈、頭痛、肢體麻木震顫、高調耳鳴、舌強語澀、甚或卒倒昏迷為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Hyperactive Liver Yang transforming into Wind, agitating upward and causing Qi/Blood chaos. Characterized by severe vertigo, limb numbness/tremors, tongue stiffness, or stroke/coma.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with thin yellow coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 中風前兆急症病機：出現肢麻、震顫、言語蹇澀為肝風內動核心。須警惕中風 (Stroke) 發生！中醫診斷多歸屬於眩暈、頭痛或中風範疇。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Stroke Precursor Warning: Numbness, tremors, or dysarthria indicates internal Wind. High alert for imminent stroke!
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Therapeutics 5 & NCCAOM 考點：代表方鎮肝熄風湯 (Zhen Gan Xi Feng Tang)。主穴：GB20 風池、GV20 百會、LR14 期門、LR3 太衝、GB34 陽陵泉、PC7 大陵。
records.treatment_principle_en: Calm Liver Wind, subdue Yang, nourish Yin

records.short_summary_zh: 腎水不足，不能上濟心火；心火偏亢，不能下溫腎水。以心煩不寐、入睡困難、心悸健忘、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、五心煩熱為特徵。
records.short_summary_en: Kidney Water failing to rise to nourish Heart, while Heart Fire flares unrestrained. Characterized by severe insomnia, difficulty falling asleep, palpitations, tinnitus, lumbar soreness, and five-center heat.

tongue_preview.en: Red tongue with red tip and scanty coating

records.differentiation_preview_zh: 心腎失調病機：心火上炎（心煩失眠、舌尖紅）與腎陰下虛（腰膝痠軟、耳鳴）並見。治療強調「交通心腎、水火相濟」。
records.differentiation_preview_en: Disharmony of Water and Fire: Heart Fire flaring (insomnia, red tip) coexisting with Kidney Yin deficiency (sore knees, tinnitus). Tx: Connect Heart and Kidney.
records.exam_pearls_zh: Bastyr Insomnia Therapeutics & NCCAOM 考點：代表方黃連阿膠湯 (Huang Lian A Jiao Tang) 或交泰丸。主穴：HT7 神門、KI3 太溪、SP6 三陰交、Anmian 安眠。
records.treatment_principle_en: Nourish Yin, clear Fire, harmonize Heart and Kidney
